throws.definition: A severe pang or spasm of pain, especially one experienced when the uterus contracts during childbirth, or when a person is about to die.

thus.definition: Frankincense obtained from conifers such as the Norway spruce, or long-leaved pine.

tic.definition: A small document that acts as proof of something, often thereby granting the holder some ability.

time.definition: The inevitable progression into the future with the passing of present and past events.

tion.definition: A cross between a male tiger and a lioness.

to.definition: Toward a closed, touching, or engaging position.

told.definition: Mental senses related to determining, reckoning, or perceiving.

took.definition: To get into one's hands, possession, or control, with or without force.

total.definition: An amount obtained by the addition of smaller amounts.

totem.definition: Any natural object or living creature that serves as an emblem of a tribe, clan or family; the representation of such an object or creature.

toucan.definition: Any of various neotropical frugivorous birds from the family Ramphastidae, with a large colorful beak.

tradition.definition: A part of culture that is passed from person to person or generation to generation, possibly differing in detail from family to family, such as the way to celebrate holidays.

transform.definition: To change greatly the appearance or form of.

travel.definition: To be on a journey, often for pleasure or business and with luggage; to go from one place to another.

treat.definition: To negotiate, discuss terms, bargain (for or with).

tree.definition: A perennial woody plant taller and larger than a shrub with a wooden trunk and, at some distance from the ground, having leaves and branches.

trees.definition: A perennial woody plant taller and larger than a shrub with a wooden trunk and, at some distance from the ground, having leaves and branches.

tried.definition: To attempt; to endeavour. Followed by infinitive.

try.definition: To attempt; to endeavour. Followed by infinitive.

turn.definition: To make a non-linear physical movement.

turned.definition: To make a non-linear physical movement.

turnip.definition: The white root of a yellow-flowered plant, Brassica rapa, grown as a vegetable and as fodder for cattle.

turns.definition: To make a non-linear physical movement.

twigs.definition: A small thin branch of a tree or bush.

twine.definition: Either of two people (or, less commonly, animals) who shared the same uterus at the same time; one who was born at the same birth as a sibling.

ugly.definition: Displeasing to the eye; aesthetically unpleasing.

unable.definition: Not able; lacking a certain ability.

unshaven.definition: Not having shaved; not shaven; untrimmed.

up.definition: Indicating movement towards or location at a higher place or position.

us.definition: The name of the Latin script letter U/u.

veneration.definition: The act of venerating or the state of being venerated.

verse.definition: A poetic form with regular meter and a fixed rhyme scheme.

versed.definition: A poetic form with regular meter and a fixed rhyme scheme.

very.definition: To a great extent or degree.

vine.definition: Any plant whose stem requires support and which climbs by tendrils or twining.

vines.definition: Any plant whose stem requires support and which climbs by tendrils or twining.

walk.definition: To move on the feet by alternately setting each foot (or pair or group of feet, in the case of animals with four or more feet) forward, with at least one foot on the ground at all times. Compare run.

walks.definition: To move on the feet by alternately setting each foot (or pair or group of feet, in the case of animals with four or more feet) forward, with at least one foot on the ground at all times. Compare run.

wall.definition: A rampart of earth, stones etc. built up for defensive purposes.

ward.definition: A warden; a guard; a guardian or watchman.

wastes.definition: Excess of material, useless by-products, or damaged, unsaleable products; garbage; rubbish.

wears.definition: An adjustable dam placed across a river to regulate the flow of water downstream.

weep.definition: To cry; to shed tears, especially when accompanied with sobbing or other difficulty speaking, as an expression of emotion such as sadness or joy.

weeping.definition: To cry; to shed tears, especially when accompanied with sobbing or other difficulty speaking, as an expression of emotion such as sadness or joy.

welkin.definition: The sky which appears to an observer on the Earth as a dome in which celestial bodies are visible; the firmament.

what.definition: In what way; to what extent.

whatever.definition: A thing or person whose actual name is unknown or forgotten.

whelk.definition: Certain edible sea snails, especially, any one of numerous species of large marine gastropods belonging to Buccinidae, much used as food in Europe.

when.definition: At what time? At which time? Upon which occasion or circumstance? Used to introduce direct or indirect questions about time.

where.definition: In, at or to what place.

while.definition: A trick or stratagem practiced for ensnaring or deception; a sly, insidious artifice.

white.definition: Bright and colourless; reflecting equal quantities of all frequencies of visible light.

who.definition: A person under discussion; a question of which person.

why.definition: The name of the Latin script letter Y/y.

will.definition: Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

willows.definition: Any of various deciduous trees or shrubs in the genus Salix, in the willow family Salicaceae, found primarily on moist soils in cooler zones in the northern hemisphere.

winged.definition: An appendage of an animal's (bird, bat, insect) body that enables it to fly.

wise.definition: Showing good judgement or the benefit of experience.

wish.definition: A desire, hope, or longing for something or for something to happen.

with.definition: A flexible, slender shoot or twig, especially when used as a band or for binding; a withy.

within.definition: In or into the interior; inside.

wondered.definition: A sense of awe, astonishment and curiosity, inspired by unexpected events, novel experiences and inexplicable circumstances, sometimes accompanied by surprise, shock or reverence.

wonders.definition: A sense of awe, astonishment and curiosity, inspired by unexpected events, novel experiences and inexplicable circumstances, sometimes accompanied by surprise, shock or reverence.

wood.definition: The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.

words.definition: Having a value of; proper to be exchanged for.

wort.definition: Now chiefly as the second element in the names of plants: a plant used for food or medicine.

would.definition: Past tense of will; usually followed by a bare infinitive.

writings.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

yard.definition: A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

yarn.definition: A twisted strand of fibre used for knitting or weaving.

years.definition: In, on, or at this place (a place perceived to be close to the speaker); compare there.

yellow.definition: The color of sunflower petals and lemons; the color obtained by mixing green and red light, or by subtracting blue from white light; the color evoked by light of wavelength around 580 nm; one of the three primary colors in subtractive color systems.

yellow-hammer.definition: A passerine bird, Emberiza citrinella, of western Eurasia, which is mainly yellow in colour.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

zealous.definition: Full of zeal; ardent, fervent; exhibiting enthusiasm or strong passion, particularly in matters of religion.

zee.definition: The name of the Latin script letter Z/z.

zone.definition: Each of the five regions of the earth's surface into which it was divided by climatic differences, namely the torrid zone (between the tropics), two temperate zones (between the tropics and the polar circles), and two frigid zones (within the polar circles).
